purpose: Place-based travel reporting through local history, authorized access, visitor capacity, resident voice, safety, and environmental change.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Verify access and conditions at production time. Respect local custodians, privacy, restricted or sacred sites, and fragile habitats; do not disclose sensitive coordinates or unsafe routes.
